# EvButtonLink

> A button link is a text-only, inline action styled as a link — used for low-emphasis or navigational actions where a full button would be too heavy.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:button-link` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvButtonLink } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvButtonLink>` or `<ev-button-link>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/button-link/EvButtonLink.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root element `.ev-button-link` |

## Example

```vue
<EvButtonLink>
  Lihat laporan
</EvButtonLink>
```

| `variant` | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'tertiary'` \| `'invert'` \| `'custom'` | `'primary'` | no | — |
| `href` | `string` | — | no | Renders an anchor instead of a button. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | — |
| `current` | `boolean` | `false` | no | The link is the current item - a breadcrumb's page. Pins the variant's `State=Active` look and sets `aria-current="page"`; without an `href` it renders as plain text, since the current page is not a destination. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Button Link**, frame `3855:54960` (Button Link). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use for low-emphasis or inline actions within or beside text.
- Use for link-like navigation (go to a page, open a doc).
- Use the Invert variant on dark or colored backgrounds.
- Use Tertiary / Secondary for de-emphasized actions in dense UI.

### When not to use

- Don't use for the primary action in a form  →  use Button (`evoq-ui:button`)
- Don't use for an on/off state  →  use Toggle (`evoq-ui:toggle`)
- Don't use as the only target in a large tap area  →  use Button (`evoq-ui:button`)
- Don't mix with filled buttons in the same action row.

### Do

- Keep labels short, verb-first, sentence case
- Style links consistently so they're recognizable
- Use Invert only on sufficiently dark surfaces
- Provide a clear focus state for keyboard users

### Don't

- Use vague labels like “Click here”
- Style a link identical to body text (not recognizable)
- Use Invert on light backgrounds (low contrast)
- Stack many links where a menu would be clearer

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvButtonLink`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root element `.ev-button-link`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:button-link` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
